description: This Java class provides utility methods for auto-closing resources, specifically for managing batch edits in input connections within an Android environment.

classes.name: GenericAutoClose
classes.description: A utility class implementing AutoCloseable to manage resource cleanup, particularly for input connection batch editing.

classes.name: ICAutoClose
classes.description: A private static subclass of GenericAutoClose that handles ending batch edits on an InputConnection.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the resource by running the provided close function.
